analysis: The PR changes only docs/provider/cli-reference.md in two places. The first is the 'Last updated' date, bumped from 2026-10-23 to 2026-10-24 (line 3). The second is the DARKBLOOM_TTFT_GDN_BLOCKED env-var table row, whose source path moves from libs/mlx-swift-lm/Libraries/MLXLLM/Models/GatedDelta.swift to libs/mlx-swift-lm/Libraries/MLXLMCommon/GatedDelta.swift (around line 1816 of the head file, outside the displayed excerpts). No code, configuration, defaults, protocol or trust-boundary behavior changes. The row's described behavior is unchanged: `0` keeps the stock Qwen GDN prompt kernel, a performance/kernel-selection toggle. I checked the changed content against the canonical threat model. T-041 (prefix cache), TB-002, TB-003, TB-007, A-008 (logout/token custody) and T-053 are not altered. The base excerpts I reviewed (lines 1-807) contain the surrounding documentation on logout, token revocation, cache and switch lifecycles, and none of it is modified by this diff. The only unverified item is whether the new source path exists, which is a doc-accuracy question and not a security regression. The changed line 1816 is not visible in the supplied text, so I rely on the patch excerpt. No security regression or threat-model gap identified.
